name: engine
description: The autonomous engine. `engine` (/engine): design a gate that can prove a task done and can fail, then build and self-verify until green. Siblings: `engine-review` (the adversarial review panel), `engine-audit` (findings as the product), `engine-planning` (a machine-checkable plan), `engine-infra` (migrations and deploys behind a guardrail harness), and `goal` (set or check the run's DONE condition).
